summary: Myo-inositol is used in polycystic ovary syndrome to improve insulin sensitivity and ovulation, often with folic acid and D-chiro-inositol (40:1). Evidence is moderate for metabolic and ovulatory outcomes.
indications: Prevention of gestational diabetes in at-risk women (limited evidence)

dosage.d: 2 g twice daily (with folic acid 200 mcg)

admin: Use only as the finished product directs
moa: Second messenger precursor in insulin and FSH signalling.
preg: Used in pregnancy studies at 2 g twice daily without harm signal
lact: Dietary amounts are safe; supplement doses not established
